observation: Actual PLATYPUS factory/CREATURE registration and default-false Sensing data belong to an existing animal; natural spawn substrate/roll, breeding/eggs/Fedora/retaliatory poison and name Easter egg were read as containing-class context and confer0. Proposed family is one paid charge-tier substrate-service lifetime, not a new breeding or natural spawn implementation.

mobInteract first handles Fedora, then chargeable tag while notSensing: snapshot superCharged from second tag, shrink1 unless player.isCreative, setSensing true and sidedSuccess. There is no explicit own server-side, adult, habitat, pending-loot or owner gate. In the shown branch charge quality is sampled before debit; no waiter/player UUID/receipt/refund is stored. Later native interaction composition and actual inventory debit were not run.

Dropped-item route is actual registered CreatureAITargetItems(false,false,40,15), requiring empty mainhand and age>40 at target selection in a radius15 cube, with current item foodstuff membership. The anonymous canUse calls super FIRST then tests !Sensing, so rejected selection may retain helper-selected target/onFind callback without starting. Continuation also tests !Sensing. Within distanceSquared<2 native helper invokes onGetItem before shrink1 and direct stop. Callback sets charge tier/Sensing only if current stack belongs to chargeables. No source claim that foodstuff/chargeable tags overlap, no Owner/pickup-delay gate at this custom sink and no recheck of food/age at debit. Shared helper itself0.

Sensing participates in shouldEnterWater unlessHasEgg; ordinary leave-water desire is suppressed while sensing but HasEgg still forces leave. FindWater1 and LeaveWater1 use MOVE/LOOK and sampled navigation requests. Dig goal priority5 declares no flags: native Goal defaults empty, so scheduler flag locking does not exclude concurrent move/panic/mate goals solely by priority; it may share navigation. Swim controller stops speed while digging, but source travel/previous velocity/navigation ordering do not establish arrival or immobility. No helper/path/collision guarantee.

Dig canUse only checks Sensing and generatePosCooldown. At0 resets20..39, searches, draws maxDroppedItems2..6, returns candidate!=null; whilepositive decrements only on eligible canUse calls. Failed search leaves Sensing and no explicit global deadline. In water, genSeafloor samples15 XZ[-7,7] currentY and descends through WATER whileY>1, accepting first digable substrate; land samples15 outerXZ[-7,7],Y+3, descendsAIR and ifWATER runs inner15 search. This is bounded per evaluation, not225 distinct references, globally bounded time or a standable reachable path. Initial canUse does not itself require water above returned substrate; continuation checks it only later.

Continuation requires targetnull, Sensing, lastHurtByMobnull, nonnull candidate, current digables tag and water above. No age/path/isInWater/current distance or elapsed deadline. Natural selector cleanup invokes wrapped stop when failed; invalid target/hurt/state ends charge with no refund. Native serverAiStep alternates full selectors and requiresUpdateEveryTick-running calls; dig inheritsfalse, so digTime counts delivered goal ticks and not unconditional world ticks/seconds.

Near distanceSquared<2 to center(substrate.above), addY-.01, stop navigation and increment digTime. Every5 delivered near updates emits event/sound request; every floor(100/maxDroppedItems) invokes reward dispatch, then at>=100 clearsSensing/Digging and resetsdigTime. Away only clearsDigging and moves; it does NOT resetdigTime, so near updates can accumulate across separations. For n2..6 under uninterrupted normal calls100 updates schedule n table rolls (interval50,33,25,20,16), not n actual item units/entities. Higher-tier selection uses current superCharged field each roll; no per-roll payment or player owner.

Reward IDs gameplay/platypus_reward or gameplay/platypus_supercharged_reward are looked up from current server loot resolver; LootParams supplies THIS_ENTITY with PIGLIN_BARTER (required onlyTHIS_ENTITY, default luck0). Manager uses current resource reload map; resolver missing table returns LootTable.EMPTY. LootTable applies pools/functions/feature-enabled splitting then Forge global modifier chain. Thus raw loot JSON absence blocks exact items, quantities/probabilities/conditions or guaranteed nonempty result; even fallback EMPTY can be modified by global hooks. No specific redstone/glowstone/diamond or default deployed table assertion.

For each returned stack, mod passes stack.copy (native preserves NBT/caps), calls spawnAtLocation then dereferences result without null guard to set impulse/reduce velocity. Native returnsnull for empty/client; otherwise constructs ItemEntity/default pickup delay, either appends to captureDrops collection or calls addFreshEntity without checking bool, then returns entity regardless admission. Global modifiers can in principle introduce empty stack; null dereference is conditional source hazard, not reproduced crash. Nonnull spawn return/event/sound/counter completion is not world-admission or material pickup receipt.

Dig stop resetsgeneratePosCooldown0, Sensingfalse, Diggingfalse, candidate null,digTime0; no charge item/refund linkage, no superCharged reset. Completion clearsSensing and counter, later wrappercleanup repeats stop; subsequent new feed overwrites tier. Own NBT storesSensing/Fedora/FromBucket/HasEgg via super, but not superCharged, candidate, progress, roll count, cooldown, swimTimer orDigging. Fresh reconstruction of active charge can restoreSensing yet fielddefault superChargedfalse/new goal counters, permitting new source-level session with normal tier. Existing-object read does not explicitly clear superCharged, so do not claim universal tier loss or live replay exploit.

Actual getBucketItemStack creates registered PLATYPUS_BUCKET; saveToBucketTag puts addAdditionalSaveData in PlatypusData. Native bucket pickup calls save/set hand/discard; ItemModFishBucket asks EntityType.spawn then restores PlatypusData and forcesFromBucket. Same partial state boundary applies to fresh bucket reconstruction, not complete verified entity admission/release/native savedata roundtrip. Broader inherited save fields and same-object reload hooks/capabilities not exhaustively expanded; ordinary NBT/transport alone0.

Player pickup is separate native ItemEntity.playerTouch: server, delay, Forge pickup hook, target permission and inventory acceptance govern copied difference/events/stats/discard. Dig does not wait for those receipts or correlate ItemEntityUUID to feedingplayer. Birth24/30/pickup9/10/strictkill0/run12 onGroundfalse are unchanged. No natural cap/local opportunity/biome proof, runtime ecology, quest award or new production behavior follows from this source reading.

Existing actor registration is CREATURE, size0.8x0.5, bucket points to that same registered type. Whole EntityPlatypus (555 lines), dig goal155, FindWater68, LeaveWater80, SwimController78, ItemModFishBucket98, target-item167 and interface23 were actually read. Spawn rolls, poison, Fedora/name, standard breeding/egg/particles are containing-class support0, not extra policy credits.

Player charging branch follows Fedora branch, requires current chargeable tag and !Sensing, snapshots super-charge membership BEFORE shrink1 unless creative, then setsSensing and returns sided success. Own branch has no explicit server/adult/terrain/ownership/output gate. No player or charge-item identity is retained, no pending payment result/refund. This is conditional sequential source order, not actual successful input or server exactly-once receipt.

Fallback expression Bucketable.bucketMobPickup(...).orElse(super.mobInteract(...)) evaluates the super argument eagerly after the bucket helper call even if Optional is present. Parent effects and custom resource intersections cannot be inferred from this expression; do not treat fallback as lazy or claim demonstrated duplicate payment. Whole bucket acquisition support and prior EA18 spawn consumer reading are reused without new semantic credit.

Dropped-item entry uses CreatureAITargetItems(false,false,40,15), empty main hand, nonempty age>40 current foodstuff stack, nearest squared distance in radius15 cube. Its anonymous canUse invokes super then !Sensing. However the actual selection predicate already includes !Sensing through canTargetItem, and onFindTarget is default no-op; super-first alone does NOT demonstrate a normal sequential rejected selection while sensing. At the debit sink current item-food/age/tag is not revalidated; callback precedes unconditional shrink1 and stop. Callback charge test snapshots tier and setsSensing; foodstuff-only items can be consumed without charging, subject to unknown actual tag contents. No ItemEntity Owner/pickup-delay gate here.

While sensing, shouldEnterWater is true only if !HasEgg; HasEgg can still force leave. Find/leave water share MOVE/LOOK at priority1. Dig priority5 never sets flags; native Goal empty flags mean it is not protected from other movement goals by locking, even at differing priorities. Shared navigation/rotation/velocity may be changed by concurrent goals. SwimController sets speed0 while Digging, not whole-entity immobility or committed arrival.

Dig canUse gates onSensing; cooldown0 resets20..39 and searches before drawing n2..6; positive cooldown decrements only on delivered evaluation. Search failure retainsSensing, with no explicit overall timeout/refund. In-water15 candidate XZ offsets[-7,7] descend through WATER whileY>1, returning first digables block; land15 outer offsets startY+3, descendAIR, and WATER candidates launch inner15 search. Repeated/random candidate positions may coincide. No path acceptance, standability, global completion bound or separate reference per sample. Initial search does not require WATER above accepted substrate; continuation checks it later.

Continuation requires no attacktarget, Sensing, lastHurtByMobnull, nonnull targetblock, current digables and WATER above. It has no own age, onGround, path success, current water or distance/elapsed deadline. Subsequent cleanup can stop and consume the service on changed terrain/hurt/state without refund. Initial start need not first pass canContinue, as inherited start is no-op. Native alternating Mob selector update paths and Goal.requiresUpdateEveryTick=false mean digTime is a count of delivered near goal updates, not100 world ticks or5 seconds.

At squared distance<2 from center(digPos.above), add downward velocity, stop navigation, incrementdigTime, request block activation/audio every5, dispatch loot at multiples of floor(100/n). At>=100 clearSensing/Digging and resettime. Away clearsDigging and requests navigation without resetting time; near progress is cumulative across separation. For n2..6 and normal uninterrupted returns up to100, intervals50/33/25/20/16 yield n table rolls, never necessarily n stacks/items/admitted entities. Every roll reads CURRENT superCharged. Feedback and100-counter completion are not output receipts.

For each returned stack copy then spawnAtLocation; ItemStack.copy preserves NBT/caps for nonempty, EMPTY for empty. Result is dereferenced without null check for impulse and velocity scaling. An empty stack after external loot processing is a conditional null hazard, not a reproduced crash. Capture collection and nonnull return do not prove world membership or player possession.

observation: Concrete registered EntityToucan constructor/registerGoals calls static initFeedingData. Config default declaration maps apple/golden apple/enchanted golden apple to oak sapling and banana to jungle sapling. Parser accepts>=2 pipe-separated fields, first item key→second block key, does not trim/validate SaplingBlock; duplicate keys overwrite map while stack-list appends. Initialization is static and skipped when init=true/nonempty. Only default declaration and local parser read, not a deployed config/reload hook proof; raw tag tier memberships absent.

mobInteract captures player stack then calls Animal.mobInteract first and ignores whether its result already consumed action. Native parent food branch on server age0/love admission shrinks1 unless creative and sets love; baby branch shrinks/ageUp; then subclass rechecks current stack mapping, SaplingTime<=0 and empty main hand, copies one into hand before another usePlayerItem shrink. Therefore when current item also breeding-tag eligible and enough count remains, two debits are conditional possible in one route; a consumed last item can prevent subclass branch. No exact tag intersection, actual reproduced double-debit or atomic fee/output receipt is claimed. Subclass itself has no adult/server gate.

Dropped route: actual FlyingAITargetDroppedItems registered target priority1 delegates previously source-read CreatureAITargetItems. Parent onFind/onGet callback occurs before caller one-shrink; sight/nearby checks are false in constructor. Toucan callback copies one, server requests old hand drop if nonempty, pecks/requests flying and overwrites hand, retaining no thrower UUID. Flying wrapper sets item flag and changes navigation, does not certify actual path/arrival. canTargetItem tests only SaplingTime<=0 and mapping, not already having pending sapling state.

Entity tick after superclass: while nonempty hand heldItemTime++; >10 and current canTargetItem then heal4/EAT/sound/remainder request, golden-tag first sets12000 else enchanted-tag setsGoldenTime(-1)/Enchanted true, converts current mapped stack into SAPLING_STATE and shrinks1. This full block lacks a side guard; GoldenTime positive decrements only server. Existing pending block intent can be overwritten by another qualifying food; enchant flag is not cleared by ordinary fruit. SaplingTime accessors exist but no assignment/decrement in this full class beyond default0; do not infer arbitrary external setter users absent. No original player payment correlation or heal/drop success receipt.

AIPlantTrees priority2 MOVE+LOOK; Goal/Selector/Wrapper source support reused. canUse only with pending state, postdecrement runCooldown<=0 then samples15 positions, X nextInt(10)-8[-8,1],Y[-4,3],Z[-8,7]. Initial gate requires pending state canSurvive(candidate), empty candidate.above and hasLineOfSightSapling, not candidate replaceable yet. Predicate compares clip result blockPos to destination only. Same-version BlockGetter.clip miss fallback uses endpoint BlockPos, BlockHitResult.miss keeps this pos; thus unobstructed MISS at endpoint qualifies. It is not a requirement to strike an existing solid sapling.

Selected candidate resets cooldown to50..89 only golden&&!enchanted, otherwise200..399; samples circle20..119 when golden else100..199. These are canUse/goal update counters, not native world ticks. tick near squared distance<3 immediately pecks/plantTime++ regardless encircleTime; away branch does not reset accumulated plantTime. Circle time controls approach height/path but is not an obligatory minimum waiting period. No overall timeout or ongoing candidate-validity check in canContinue beyond pos/pending state.

At plantTime>60, tests current state canSurvive and current candidate block replaceable, requests setBlockAndUpdate, clears pending state iff !Enchanted without checking returned bool, then directly stop resets position/time/itemFlag even on failed validation. Native Level setter can returnfalse for outside height/debug/null chunk mutation, uses flags3 and snapshot-aware notifications; lower chunk/event result not expanded. Nonenchanted intent can be lost after refused write; enchanted intent retained after valid request and after failure, supporting repeated future placement attempts with same seed-state. No explicit mobGriefing/permission guard in this local route; no runtime griefing outcome asserted.

Native default SaplingBlock startsSTAGE0; Bush.canSurvive delegates Forge canSustainPlant for this state, whose full lower implementation is not expanded. Sapling randomTick needs loaded neighborhood,brightness>=9 and1/7; next stage or treeGrower request occurs later. Toucan only requests configured default block placement, does not bonemeal or create a mature tree. Tree-grower/features/actual sapling type resolution/current loaded config not proof-expanded. A named planting success is not native mature-tree or harvest receipt.

Own NBT writes pending SaplingState if nonnull,Variant,GoldenTime,Enchanted; read missing/air sapling clears intent. Main actually read native Mob hand-items writer/reader so hand stacks have superclass serialization requests too; ItemStack.of/save payload internals not newly expanded. Own heldItemTime,goal candidate/circle/plantTime/cooldown,FLYING/PECK/SaplingTime not explicitly stored here. Fresh reconstruction resets transient state while kept intent/enchantment can continue; read into an existing instance is not a general reset proof. Existing default sapling intent, positive golden server clock and enchant persistence are one service policy, not extra migration/variant credit.

Whole794-line EntityToucan and60-line Flying target wrapper actually read, plus config/registry/tag bounds. RegistrationCREATURE0.45x0.45 establishes type/factory, not natural admission. Constructor/registerGoals initialize static item→block map from strings split on pipe; >=2 accepted, firsttwo used, no trim/SaplingBlock validation. Duplicate item keys overwrite map while list appends. Nonempty initialized map skips refresh; defaults are declarations, not loaded current config or proven valid registry entries. Standard spawn/breed/variants/movement helpers0.

getSaplingFor requires nonempty stack with registry key mapped, resolves BLOCKS and returns its defaultBlockState whennonnull. Config can map to arbitrary blocks, not necessarily a tree. Declared four defaults are identifiable source strings only. Three breed/golden/enchant item tags are tree metadata without raw contents. No default tag memberships, material availability, loaded map success or golden-apple economic path is proved.

mobInteract captures mutable player stack, calls Animal parent FIRST, then ignores whether action was consumed. Native adult server age0 and canFallInLove consumes1 unlessinstabuild and setsLove600, baby route consumes/grows. Only after that subclass tests current mapping, SaplingTime<=0 and emptyhand, copies1 tohand, then usePlayerItem consumesagain. Flying dropped goal age>15/radius16 inherits empty mainhand/nearest target and callback-before-shrink from actual prior whole helper read. executionChance1 removes that RNG failure but idle/world-time/path gates remain. Parent canUse first then attacktarget guard; current mapping/SaplingTime predicate runs on selection, not every debit. Toucan onGetItem copies1 with NBT/caps, conditionally requests old hand drop on server, pecks/setsFlying and overwrites hand; parent then shrinks original1. No thrower ownership token/pickup-delay receipt. Flight requests/hasLineOfSight branches not certified arrival.

In tick, heldItemTime increments while nonempty; >10 and current canTargetItem heals4 request/EAT/audio/remainder drop, then golden membership FIRST setsGoldenTime12000, else enchant membership sets-1/Enchantedtrue. A stack matching both takes golden branch. Ordinary fruit does not clear Enchanted. Maps current held stack into SaplingState before shrinking1. This block lacks own side guard; positiveGoldenTime only decrements server. Health/remainders/packet/actual client-server composition and item retain/consume success not proved.

SaplingTime has default0/get/set but no own call that sets or decrements it elsewhere in the full class; no global external-setter absence claim. Pending SaplingState is NOT a canTargetItem or hand-feed exclusion, so later qualifying food can replace pending intent after held-time check. It is one retained block-state service, not an immutable per-food queue. Variant/name/Fedora-like cosmetics and each tier/support helper0.

AIPlantTrees priority2 MOVE/LOOK uses canUse pending state plus postdecrement runCooldown<=0. Samples15 candidates with biased X[-8,1],Y[-4,3],Z[-8,7], accepting first with state.canSurvive, empty ABOVE and destination-blockpos line-of-sight, not current candidate replaceability. Native clip MISS fallback stores endpoint containing blockpos; BlockHitResult keeps this pos, so an unobstructed MISS endpoint can qualify. It need not hit a solid existing sapling; collider/fluidNONE/terrain and navigator internals are not a reachability guarantee.

Cooldown50..89 onlyGolden&&!Enchanted, else200..399; chosen encircle duration20..119 ifGolden else100..199. These count eligible canUse/goal updates, not unconditional worldticks. Native separate target/goal selectors have their own locks, so item pursuit and goal movement can affect shared controls. Existing read of flags/scheduler is reused, not extra mechanism. No finite wallclock completion guarantee.

Tick setsaiItemFlag, decrementsencircleTime, but near squared distance<3 immediately stopsflying/pecks/plantTime++ without waiting for encircleTime0. Away does not reset plantTime. Thus61 near qualifying updates may accumulate across separation and during encircling; no requirement to finish circle then stand61consecutive ticks. It may land/setflyingfalse before encircle ends. observation: 真实ItemHandler seed注册和useOn→spawnCreature调用：客户端直接SUCCESS，服务器需mayUseItemAt，但实际坐标始终clickedPos上1而非relative(facing)；MOB_SUMMONED finalize后checkSpawnRules检验碰撞/无液体/grass,dirt,leaves，再调用addFreshEntity。忽略add结果仍返回entity，所以useOn可能消费种子而未入世，SUCCESS也不代表出生。
完整幼苗tick仅在server hungry且NO_ANIMATION时扫描近处ItemEntity，肉tag并foodProperties非空才split1；有实际物品后incrementGrowth、hungry=false并动画反馈。玩家持肉只影响张口activate，不能替代真实掉落物消耗。

服务端非hungry时每tickCount%20==0成长+1，growth<600设置infant并清hungry；growth恰好600/1200/1800设置hungry，使成长等待肉；growth恰好2400创建新成体、复制位置、setCanDespawn(false)、addFreshEntity，然后无条件discard幼苗。三个阈值和替换均用==，未证明跳过阈值/异常存档时具备自纠正。
成熟替换没有finalizeSpawn/checkSpawnRules/出生成功结果保护；幼苗discard不等于死亡或击杀，成人是新entity，源码只复制位置和设置持久性，不保留幼苗UUID/名字等全部状态。不能凭幼苗消失或反馈证明成体已加入。
幼苗额外NBT只写tickGrowth；hungry/infant/eating没有本类额外保存，靠tick相等平台条件/初始值重算，重载时细粒度相位与动画未证完全恢复。成体canDespawn序列化存在，其requiresCustomPersistence返回!flag。父checkDespawn先执行EventHooks及Peaceful条件，再决定距离分支是否跳过，非不死或全部原因不清理。
application: 生态证据应把可种植后备种群与NATURAL抽取分开，逐项记录真实食物消耗、时间平台、旧实体退出和新实体实际入世，不能以客户端动画或返回SUCCESS代替事实。
借鉴成长阶段、饥饿门及成熟后保留玩家培育个体的生命周期划分；真正实施前须验证原子交接/状态继承/重载及cap计数，1000前不制作新繁殖或改类别。
limits: 这是实际模组玩家种植/喂食种群生命周期参考，不能证明野外出生、种子自然掉落来源、物品tag实际部署非空或生态缺口已解决。两类型MONSTER并不说明其count/周期可与CREATURE互换。
AnimationHandler/LLibrary网络内部未全文审，goal配对/本地动画推进仅支持调用边界，不声称客户端渲染、精确进食时长运行成功。
外部vanilla/NeoForge生存/加入/存档/cap消费未执行；持久性不是免疫PEACEFUL/event/伤害。未验证默认难度下EventHooks具体结果。
源码是固定NeoForge版本，不直接推成本项目Forge API可编译。未执行下载代码/编译/游戏/测试，未研究建筑资产或生产改动。
substantive_fields_actually_read.deduplication: 与EA10巢内保存同类实体延时重建不同，本项玩家种植后消耗掉落肉、离散生长饥饿平台、成熟替换不同entity type并改变个体持久性。与EA11临时trader同步寿命退出相反；与EA9结构生成固定cohort不同。成体持久性setter/序列化/动画包装全部支持0，不按种子/幼苗/成体/3平台拆项；未来其他同模板成长植物合并。
